name: 凯文·埃斯维尔特
bio_short: 美国生物学家，麻省理工学院（MIT）媒体实验室教授。他是CRISPR“基因驱动”技术的提出者（`gene_drive_2014`），但他同时也是该技术最严厉的警哨人，致力于倡导生物技术的生态安全和道德规范，防止不受控制的基因扩散。
bio_short_en: An American biologist and professor at the MIT Media Lab. He proposed the CRISPR-based 'Gene Drive' technology (`gene_drive_2014`). However, he is also its harshest whistleblower, dedicated to advocating for ecological safety and ethical standards in biotechnology to prevent uncontrolled genetic spread.
